properties.name: A claim names its owner, and a claim with no live owner is reported stale
properties.statement: A claim records the session that made it (its harness session id — assigned out of band, so it cannot race), and claim_report distinguishes a claim held by a live seat from one left behind by a session that closed. Liveness is computed from the owner, not asserted by the claim: a claim nobody is working is a ghost that makes the overlap report lie.
